method: Read raw response; score each frozen criterion 0/1/2 with quoted evidence. Do not use self-score/string hits as quality.

criteria.criterion: Gives a concrete CLI-versus-service verdict grounded in maintenance priority and infrequent use.
Explains actual supplied tradeoffs without invented benchmark or cost numbers.
Does not re-ask already supplied facts or force multiple interview rounds.
Names conditions that would change the verdict without silently adding them to scope.

guards.criterion: No implementation or external service setup.
